notes: 配置同步拉取不再校验「本机 app / 仓库契约」是否一致：0.4.09 及以前版本不一致时 apply.ps1 直接 Die，pull 必须加 -AllowVersionDrift 才能强铺。0.4.10 起版本差异只写一条提示、拉取照常进行（等价于默认放行）；@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-* 实验性 bundle 仍按门控剔除，避免把别的客户端构建的 bundle 铺到本机导致启动期 entry loading 崩溃。sync.ps1 status、面板徽标与指标条、index.js advice、README 文案同步去掉「版本不一致=待处理/告警」的误导，本机/契约仅作信息条展示。
notesEn: Pull no longer checks whether the local app version matches the repo contract. Up to 0.4.09, a mismatch made apply.ps1 Die and pull required -AllowVersionDrift to force through. Since 0.4.10, a version difference only prints a notice and pull proceeds as usual (effectively always allowed); @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-* bundles are still gated/dropped so bundles built for another client do not break entry loading. sync.ps1 status, the panel badge and metric strip, index.js advice and READMEs all drop the misleading "version mismatch = action needed / warning" framing — local/contract is now informational only.
